fullPassage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is the search for meaning. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to change their attitude toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.

② He blamed himself(자기 탓으로 여김): 죄책감이 아니라 의미 발견

③ He wished he had died together(함께 죽기를 바람): 본문에 없음

④ his pain would never end(고통이 끝나지 않을 것): 오히려 우울증이 끝남 — 반대
det.tip: 내가 대신 아파서 아내가 안 아파도 됐다 → 고통에 의미가 생김

ch: His suffering had a purpose because it protected his wife from the same pain.
He blamed himself for causing his wife's death.
He wished he had died together with his wife.
He believed his emotional pain would never end.

questions.passage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is the search for meaning. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to change their attitude toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without <u>him</u>. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>him</u>이 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: him = 그 우울한 남자(아내를 잃은 남편)
det.analysis:
① Frankl: 상담을 진행한 의사이지 지칭 대상 아님

② 그 우울한 남자: 'if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him'에서 he와 him은 모두 상담받던 그 남자(남편)를 가리킴 ←정답

③ 남자의 아내: without him의 him은 아내가 아니라 남편

④ 또 다른 환자: 본문에 등장하지 않음
det.tip: if he(남자) had died first ... live without him(남자) — he와 him 모두 그 남자

questions.passage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: how he had died alone=그가 홀로 어떻게 죽었는지 / why his wife left him=아내가 왜 떠났는지 / what he was going through=그가 겪고 있던 것 / when his depression began=우울증이 언제 시작됐는지
det.analysis:
① how he had died alone: 그는 죽지 않았으므로 부적절

② why his wife left him: 아내는 떠난 것이 아니라 사망함 — 부적절

③ what he was going through: 아내가 그가 '겪고 있던 것(고통)'을 겪지 않아도 되었다 ←정답

④ when his depression began: 우울증 시작 시점은 문맥과 무관
det.tip: did not have to experience _____ → 그가 겪던 고통 → what he was going through

For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had ①<u>die</u> first and his wife had been forced to live without him. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①은 어법상 틀렸다. 어법에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 (1단어, 영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: die → died (had 다음에는 과거분사: 가정법 과거완료 had died)
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 부분은 'what would have happened if he had die first' 자리예요.

→ 'if + 주어 + had + 과거분사'는 가정법 과거완료로, had 다음에는 반드시 과거분사가 와요.

→ 따라서 원형 die를 과거분사 died로 고쳐 써요. (die의 과거분사는 died)
det.tip: had + 과거분사. had die(X) → had died(O)

questions.passage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (영어로)
'그는 그 남자에게 ~을 생각해 보라고 했다'
[조건] (1) about, asked, he, man, the, think, to를 모두 사용
(2) 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: he asked the man to think about = 그는 그 남자에게 ~을 생각해 보라고 했다
det.analysis:
'ask + 목적어 + to부정사'는 '~에게 …하라고 요청하다/시키다'라는 구문이에요.

→ 주어(he)+동사(asked)+목적어(the man)+to부정사(to think)+전치사(about) 순으로 배열해요.

→ '~에게 …하라고 했다'는 ask A to B 형태로 쓰며, 여기서는 뒤에 생각할 내용(about ~)이 이어져요.
det.tip: ask + 목적어 + to부정사 = ~에게 …하라고 하다. he asked the man to think about

questions.wa: he asked the man to think about
accept: he asked the man to think about

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [보기]의 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오. (9단어, 영어로)
'그의 아내가 그 없이 살도록 강요당했다'
[보기] been, forced, had, him, his, live, to, wife, without

det.korean: his wife had been forced to live without him = 그의 아내가 그 없이 살도록 강요당했다
det.analysis:
주어(his wife)+수동태 과거완료(had been forced)+to부정사(to live)+전치사구(without him) 순으로 배열해요.

→ '강요당했다'는 수동이라 had been forced(had been + 과거분사)를 쓰고, 'force + 목적어 + to부정사'가 수동이 되면 'be forced to live'가 돼요.

→ '그 없이'는 without him으로 마무리해요.
det.tip: had been forced to live: 살도록 강요당했다(수동태 + to부정사)
